info.name: CityCare API
info.description:
CityCare API — 94 requests across every module.

Start with the **0 — Start here** folder: health check, then the three seeded logins. Tokens and ids (complaintId, categoryId, paymentId …) are saved into the environment automatically by test scripts, so the requests chain together.

Import `citycare.postman_environment.json` first and select it, top right.

Full walkthrough: docs/postman-guide.md in the repository.

item.name: 0 — Start here
item.description: Run these four in order after `pnpm run db:seed`. Each login stores its access token in the variable its role needs (adminToken / officerToken / citizenToken), so every other folder works without copying anything by hand.

attachment. `REJECTED` requires a note. Two concurrent calls give one 200 and one 409.
